debts = []
for line in note_content.split('\n'):
    line = line.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith('#'):
        continue
    # Format: "X owes me => $amount" or "I owe X => $amount"
    if 'owes me' in line:
        parts = line.split('owes me =>')
        person = parts[0].strip()
        amount = float(parts[1].strip().replace('$', ''))
        debts.append({'person': person, 'amount': amount, 'direction': 'request'})
    elif 'I owe' in line:
        parts = line.split('I owe')
        person = parts[1].split('=>')[0].strip()
        amount = float(parts[1].split('=>')[1].strip().replace('$', ''))
        debts.append({'person': person, 'amount': amount, 'direction': 'pay'})

print(debts)
